voices.label: 여성
voices.direction: An original adult feminine voice, clear warm mid-high register, expressive fantasy game acting, consistent speaker throughout all takes.

voices.label: 남성
voices.direction: An original adult masculine voice, warm mid-low register, expressive fantasy game acting, consistent speaker throughout all takes.

emotions.label: 기본
emotions.direction: A short relaxed curious hmm, conversational and neutral.

emotions.label: 기쁨
emotions.direction: A light warm joyful chuckle, naturally smiling.

emotions.label: 분노
emotions.direction: A firm irritated hmpf with controlled anger, no shouting.

emotions.label: 놀람
emotions.direction: A quick surprised gasp, sudden but not a scream.

emotions.label: 슬픔
emotions.direction: A soft dejected sigh with restrained sadness.

emotions.label: 부끄러움
emotions.direction: A hesitant breathy uh with shy nervousness.

emotions.label: 두려움
emotions.direction: A short fearful gasp with a tremble in the breath.

emotions.label: 짜증
emotions.direction: A dry disapproving tongue click with an annoyed sigh.

emotions.label: 애정
emotions.direction: A gentle warm affectionate hum, subtle and tender.

notes: Same speaker identity for all emotions in each voice bank.
Clean dry mono voice only; no music, effects, room noise or reverb.
No real-person imitation or voice cloning.
Guide syllables communicate delivery; no sentences or English phrases.
Generate/record 18 main cues first. Two variants per emotion can follow after audition.
No NPC gender inferred from names. Auditions are not applied to the game.
